title: Project ZIP bundles a populated .env file
evidence_summary: The ZIP contains .env including APP_KEY and configured service settings; .git history is also bundled. This is a distribution/security issue even though .gitignore excludes .env.
recommended_action: Rebuild clean deployment archives excluding .env, .git, logs, local backups and private assets; assess credential rotation if the archive was shared outside trusted developers. Do not rotate APP_KEY in production without an encrypted-data impact plan.

title: Business records absent from uploaded database
evidence_summary: 126 CREATE TABLE statements, only eight tables with INSERT statements. There are 0 students, enrollments, attendance, invoices, payments, marks, journals and employees; only one institution exists.
source_reference: scm-system.sql: INSERT INTO blocks; institutions, users and sms_permissions
recommended_action: Create a fresh isolated demo database and run initial seeders there. Do not import a full demo dump into this working database.

title: Provided demo seeders do not fit the existing database
evidence_summary: SmsFullDemoSeeder refuses any existing users/institutions, and SmsExtendedDemoSeeder explicitly requires all three demo institutions and existing student data. Current dump contains SCHDEMO only.
recommended_action: Use a clean empty database for the 3-institution demo; for the current school build a specially reviewed additive school-only seeder. Do not force-run or disable seeder safeguards.

title: API routes and API tests are not executable as delivered
evidence_summary: routes/sms_api.php exists but bootstrap/app.php does not register an API routing file; routes/api.php is absent; laravel/sanctum is not in composer.lock, while TenantIsolationTest invokes Sanctum.
recommended_action: Either remove/defer the unused API tests or properly install/configure Sanctum, register API routes and create a real isolated-database test suite.

title: Ledger transaction idempotency has a concurrency gap
evidence_summary: Service checks whether a source journal already exists using lockForUpdate, but schema has no unique key on (institution_id, source_type, source_reference). Concurrent non-existent-row checks may both succeed.
recommended_action: Add a unique source-reference constraint after auditing existing duplicates; add concurrency tests with two simultaneous payment requests.

title: Teacher subject authorization is not enforced in marks workflow
evidence_summary: The exam-mark workflow checks permission marks.enter, paper, student and class, but does not verify the acting teacher is assigned to the exam subject/class.
recommended_action: Require assigned teacher or specific privileged academic-override permission; test unauthorized teacher access.

title: Generic export/read access exceeds least privilege for sensitive data
evidence_summary: One module-level view permission exposes all listed tables in that module; finance fees.view includes general-ledger/bank records, and authorized generic CSV exports omit only keyword-based columns. Student welfare/health data needs field-level policy.
recommended_action: Add table-specific authorization and vetted export allowlists; explicitly protect health, incident, contacts, payroll, documents and audit records.

title: Approval separation can fall back to permissive behavior if audit record is absent
evidence_summary: Refund and payroll approval logic rejects the same actor only when an originating audit actor was found. Missing source audit rows do not fail closed.
recommended_action: Persist requested_by/approved_by columns or immutable approver records; reject when originator cannot be verified.

title: Accounting workflows are only partial
evidence_summary: Current source supports invoice, payment, refund and balance comparison; payroll approval does not disburse or post liabilities, bank comparison cannot reconcile transaction lines, and fee plan billing is not automated.
recommended_action: Add validated accounting period workflow, recurring fee engine, payroll liabilities/disbursement, bank statement line matching, cashbook and reconciliation integration tests.

title: Stated production target differs from exported database engine
evidence_summary: The export is from MariaDB 10.4.32 rather than MySQL 8; schema equivalence alone does not establish MySQL 8 compatibility.
recommended_action: Run migrations and workflow tests on the actual production-intended database version; preserve the MariaDB version when restoring this export.

title: Full runtime regression and security tests not demonstrated
evidence_summary: There are 20 navigation module definitions, 27 workflow definitions and 50 editable register allowlists, but no live MySQL/browser UAT evidence. The local analysis runtime lacks PHP mbstring/dom/xmlwriter and PDO MySQL.
source_reference: source code and local static test logs
recommended_action: Run php artisan test, sms:qa and role-based acceptance tests on a local/staging PHP 8.2+ installation with required extensions.

title: Database session table absent in supplied dump
evidence_summary: The database contains cache and cache_locks but no sessions table. File sessions are configured in the supplied .env and working locally.
recommended_action: Keep SESSION_DRIVER=file for local use; if switching to database sessions, create the sessions migration and test restore and deployment.

title: Module screens are not equivalent to complete workflows
evidence_summary: 111 registered tables and 50 editable registers exist; many features (notifications, production integrations, advanced LMS, biometric, CGPA, finance closing) remain incomplete.
recommended_action: Close each workflow with data setup, success/failure cases, role checks, integration tests, and sign-off evidence.
